wrong_entity_rate.description: Fraction of retrieved evidence chunks whose company does not match the benchmark item company scope.

wrong_period_rate.description: Fraction of retrieved evidence chunks whose reporting period falls outside the target_periods scope.

unsupported_claim_rate.description: Fraction of extracted claims judged unsupported by the verifier.

subquestion_completion_rate.description: Fraction of all generated subquestions that finished in completed state.

required_subquestion_coverage.description: Fraction of required subquestions that reached completed state.

required_slot_coverage.description: Fraction of must-cover slots that were covered by completed subquestions.

decision_trace_coverage.description: Fraction of subquestions that have at least one controller decision record.

decision_replay_consistency.description: Whether replayed subquestion states and controller decisions match the final result object.

retrieval_hit.description: Whether the system retrieved at least one gold evidence document for the item.

verified_claim_coverage.description: Fraction of extracted claims that the verifier judged supported by bound evidence.

citation_marker_coverage.description: Fraction of extracted claims that include citation markers, regardless of whether support is verified.

required_fact_recall.description: Coverage of must-cover concepts or required facts in the final memo text.

answer_quality.description: Holistic quality score for completeness, balance, and evidence use, after trust and controller caps are applied.

failure_tags.description: Flat list of failure labels covering safety, controller, and answer quality problems.
